facts.fact: Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation Avinash Ramtohul spoke on 16 July 2026 of the government's commitment to digital governance through the implementation of a National Data Governance Strategy, presenting it as in implementation; the document gives no approval or launch date.

note: One passing ministerial mention of implementing a National Data Governance Strategy; no body or rule tied to it. Amendments to the Data Protection Act are class other.
